verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own card-spend tracking, and its spend-management AI claims real-time visibility, but that claim is specifically about purchase orders linked to bills, not a live spend dashboard. Nothing shows spend broken down by team, category, or merchant, or confirms card transactions appear the same day. Missing for 10: same-day real-time card spend feed, breakdowns by team/category/merchant, reporting or dashboard documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: Track card spending and reimburse employees worldwide
Purchase orders automatically linked to bills and line items, giving you real-time visibility.
